intitule: Parts of the Body - Labeling Exercise

enonce.texte:
Identify and write the correct names for the following parts of the body:

  • 1. The part of the body used for seeing.
  • 2. The part of the body used for hearing.
  • 3. The part of the body used for smelling.
  • 4. The part of the body used for walking.
  • 5. The part of the body that pumps blood.
images: A simple human body outline with blank spaces to label the parts mentioned.

questions.texte: Identify the body part used for seeing.
Identify the body part used for hearing.
Identify the body part used for smelling.
Identify the body part used for walking.
Identify the body part that pumps blood.

enonce.texte:
Complete the sentences with 'have got' or 'has got'.

Remember: I/you/we/they → have got   |   he/she/it → has got

questions.texte: She ______ a headache.
They ______ many friends in Douala.
He ______ a fever and a cough.
I ______ a new phone.

enonce.texte: Read the following situations and write what you would say to the doctor. Use 'I have got' or 'I have' to describe your symptoms.
images: A patient sitting in a doctor's office, holding their head and looking uncomfortable.

questions.texte: You have a very high temperature and you feel very hot.
You feel pain in your head.
Your stomach is painful.
You have a pain in your back.

enonce.texte:
You are feeling sick. Write a short dialogue between you and the receptionist to make a doctor's appointment. Include:

  • A polite greeting.
  • An explanation of your symptoms (use 'I have got' or 'I have').
  • Asking for an appointment time.
  • Asking for the doctor's advice.
images: A person talking to a receptionist at a hospital reception desk.

questions.texte: Write a dialogue to make a doctor's appointment.
questions.reponse: Patient: Good morning. I would like to see a doctor. Receptionist: Good morning. What is the problem? Patient: I have got a terrible headache and a fever. I feel very tired. Receptionist: Please sit down. The doctor will see you in 30 minutes. Patient: Thank you very much.

sousQuestions.reponse: I have got a terrible headache and a fever. I feel very tired.

sousQuestions.texte: What did you ask the receptionist?
sousQuestions.reponse: I asked to see a doctor and asked for an appointment.

enonce.texte: Create a dialogue between a doctor and a patient. The patient has symptoms (headache, fever, stomach pain, or cough). Use at least 5 sentences. Use 'have got' or 'has got' and imperative forms (like 'Take this medicine', 'Drink water', 'Rest well').
images: A doctor examining a patient in a consultation room.

questions.texte: Write a dialogue between a doctor and a patient.
questions.reponse: Doctor: Good morning. What is the problem? Patient: Good morning. I have got a bad headache and a fever. I also feel very tired. Doctor: Let me check your temperature. Yes, you have got a fever. Do you have a cough? Patient: Yes, I have got a cough too. Doctor: You need to rest well. Take this medicine twice a day. Drink a lot of water. Patient: Thank you, doctor.

sousQuestions.texte: What symptoms did the patient describe?
sousQuestions.reponse: A bad headache, a fever, and a cough.

sousQuestions.texte: What advice did the doctor give?
sousQuestions.reponse: Rest well, take medicine twice a day, and drink a lot of water.

enonce.texte: Create questions you could ask to get medical help in the following situations using the words in parentheses.

questions.texte: You want to ask the pharmacist for medicine for a headache. (excuse me / headache / medicine)
questions.reponse: Excuse me, do you have medicine for a headache?

questions.texte: You want to know where the hospital is. (excuse me / where / hospital)
questions.reponse: Excuse me, where is the hospital?

questions.texte: You want to ask the doctor if you can go to school. (can I / go to school / doctor)
questions.reponse: Doctor, can I go to school?

enonce.texte:
Read the doctor's advice below and summarize it in your own words. Then, translate the key advice into French for a patient who doesn't understand English.

Doctor's Advice: "You have got a viral infection. You need to take this medication three times a day. Drink plenty of water and get enough rest. Avoid eating cold foods and stay warm."
images: A doctor giving advice to a patient while writing a prescription.

questions.texte: Summarize the doctor's advice in English.
questions.reponse: The patient has a viral infection and must take medication three times a day. They should drink water, rest, avoid cold food, and keep warm.

questions.texte: Translate the key advice into French.
questions.reponse: Vous avez une infection virale. Vous devez prendre ce médicament trois fois par jour. Buvez beaucoup d'eau et reposez-vous. Évitez les aliments froids et gardez-vous au chaud.
